title: Collection of elements in neumorphic style
lede: A 2020 stock-vector sheet of neumorphic knobs, toggles, sliders, and menus, now the lead image of the Wikipedia article.
summary: Vectorium’s stock sheet of soft UI controls on one pale gray surface with a single blue accent.

evidence.note: Opened the Commons 1280 px rendition of `File:Neumorphism.jpg` (original 2000 × 2000). The Freepik source page returned HTTP 403, so its license and date were not checked there.

styles.note: A clear catalogue of the style’s control grammar: every knob, switch, slider, and menu is molded from one pale gray surface, and one blue marks selection.

context: Commons gives the source as Freepik (“collection-elements-neumorphic-style_8507495”), the author as Vectorium, the date as 2020, and a CC BY-SA 4.0 license. It was uploaded on 21 October 2020 by the user Le Paragone, not by the author.

A second file, `File:Neumorphism-fixed.jpg` (uploaded 29 January 2026 by Awesomecat), corrects the misspelled “Accept” button; the English Wikipedia article [Neumorphism](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neumorphism) uses it.
observed: About thirty controls on a light gray square: two large dials with tick marks, a round knob in a blue ring, a pie selector, a nine-dot grid, toggles, sliders, dropdowns, a “Pop Up” card, media buttons, and round icon buttons.
Every control is the same gray as the background, with a white highlight at upper left and a soft gray shadow at lower right. Inputs, slider tracks, and the “Name” field are pressed in.
One mid blue fills the selected items, progress segments, and the “Cancel” button. Icons and text are dark gray.
Corners are fully round on pills and buttons and about 20 px on cards. Type is a geometric sans-serif (Montserrat-like).
interpretation: Stock sheets like this spread the style as ready-made parts. It follows the recipe closely and shows how the style favors physical controls (dials, knobs, rockers) over text.

rights.statement: Commons records CC BY-SA 4.0, but the file was uploaded by a third party from Freepik, whose own license does not grant CC BY-SA. The license claim is doubtful, so the image is not stored.
